title: TOEFL Reading Strategies
ringkas: Gagasan utama, detail, inferensi, dan kosakata dalam konteks
goals: menjawab soal **detail, inferensi, dan referensi kata ganti**
membaca teks akademik dalam **waktu sekitar 11 menit per teks**

lesson.text: Bagian **Reading** terdiri dari lima teks akademik, masing-masing dengan sekitar sepuluh soal. Waktu sangat terbatas, jadi kamu harus **membaca selektif**. Kenali jenis soal dan tahu di mana mencari jawabannya.

lesson.title: 1. Jenis soal Reading
table: [[What is the main topic of the passage?]]
baca kalimat pertama dan terakhir paragraf
scan kata kunci, baca kalimat sekitarnya
[[The word 'significant' is closest in meaning to ...]]
[[All of the following are mentioned EXCEPT ...]]
coret opsi yang ada di teks
simpulkan dari fakta, jangan menebak di luar teks

lesson.title: 2. Strategi waktu
table: Baca sekilas judul dan kalimat pertama tiap paragraf (1 menit)
Jangan menghabiskan lebih dari 1 menit per soal
Sisakan 2 menit untuk soal yang ditandai

lesson.title: Pelajari kata penghubung teks
lesson.text: Kata seperti *however*, *for example*, *in contrast*, dan *therefore* membantu menemukan gagasan utama, contoh, dan kesimpulan.

items: NOT: coret yang ada di teks.
Inferensi: simpulkan dari fakta di teks.

practice.q: Teks: "Coral reefs are among the most diverse ecosystems on Earth, even though they cover less than one percent of the ocean floor. They protect coasts from storms, provide food for millions of people, and support a quarter of all marine species. However, rising ocean temperatures cause corals to lose the algae that give them colour and energy. This process, called bleaching, can kill an entire reef if the heat lasts too long. Scientists therefore urge governments to reduce carbon emissions, which warm the oceans."  ·  What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Coral reefs are valuable but threatened by warming oceans
Coral reefs cover most of the ocean

practice.q: Teks: "The printing press, invented in the fifteenth century, transformed how information spread. Before it, books were copied by hand, which made them rare and expensive. After the press appeared, books became cheaper, and literacy rates rose steadily. As a result, new ideas about science and religion travelled quickly across Europe. Some historians argue that this change played an important role in the Renaissance."  ·  What is the main topic of the passage?
options: The effect of the printing press on information
The history of books in Asia at the moment
The invention of paper in general
The decline of literacy at that time
